item.title: No Grass, Please! - Dinosaur Digs Overhaul Pack
item.description: “No Grass, Please!” is an ambitious attempt to rectify some of the mistakes made by Blue Fang and adapt Dinosaur Digs as much as possible to present-day science.

item.title: Portable Restrooms
item.description: A mundane, plastic portable restroom for lower-budget zoos and parks. Functional restroom for guests, with a capacity of 2 (same as ingame Small Restrooms).

item.title: Modern Wooden Fences
item.description: Adds a set of modern wooden fences to your zoo created by Vondell.

item.title: Perentie
item.description: Perenties are fairly large lizards in the monitor family.

item.title: Nile Monitor
item.description: The Nile Monitor is a large, fast, and agile lizard from the rainforest outskirts and grasslands of Africa.
